There are two types of pallets:
* {{item|corpse}} pallets
* {{item|crates}} pallets

==Corpse pallets==
The pallet can be used to store one [[corpse]] with a reduced amount of decay. Each pallet increases the {{Morgue Capacity}} by one. There are also [[double pallet]]s and [[fridge pallet]]s for more elaborate corpse storage.

For more information about how corpses and corpse rating works see the [[corpse]] main page and for more information about preparing bodies see the [[morgue]].

==Crate pallets==
The pallets for [[crates]] are built in the [[barn cellar]] by the [[crate factory]] or located in the [[trade office]]. They are used to deposit [[crates]] with [[items|goods]] to be sold by the [[merchant]].

For more information follow the links of this section.
